problem: v1.1.0 made the product understandable and discoverable, but the active laboratory workbench still inherits uneven typography, dense controls, inconsistent editor/output sizing, weak lab context, and no obvious escape path back to laboratory discovery.
workbench_contract: every laboratory is wrapped in one consistent editorial workbench frame
the active lab number, title, and purpose remain visible at the top of the workbench
a Back to laboratories action returns users to discovery without changing lab state
primary editors use readable monospace sizing and minimum working height
known output surfaces use readable line-height, stable minimum height, and contained overflow
interactive controls expose clear keyboard focus and usable target heights
mobile workbench layout remains horizontally contained
reduced-motion preferences suppress nonessential workbench animation
all v1.1.0, v1.0.1, and P12 certification gates remain mandatory

certification_basis.repository_v110: pass with guarded live v1.1.0 verification

promotion_rule: Promote only after repository certification plus desktop/mobile P12, v1.0.1 exhaustive interaction, v1.1.0 usability, and v1.2.0 workbench browser gates all pass on the metadata-complete candidate head.
